name: Sales Analytics Dashboard & Custom Date Range

planSteps.description: Switch to Kitchen view and click 'ยอดขายวันนี้ (Sales Analytics)' button in the top bar
Sales Dashboard modal opens with dark slate header, emerald icon, and glassmorphic backdrop overlay
Four KPI cards display Total Sales (฿), Total Orders, Average Ticket Size, and Payment Split percentage
Click time preset filter '7 วันล่าสุด (7 Days)'
KPI stat values, 5 Best Selling Dishes list, and 24-Hour Peak Hours traffic graph update immediately
Click 'กำหนดช่วงเวลา (Custom Range)' preset
Custom Date Range drawer opens showing Start Date card, End Date card, formatted date labels, and shortcut chips
Click 'เดือนนี้ (This Month)' shortcut chip
Start and End dates update to the 1st of current month and today's date with selected days badge
Click 'CSV' export button in the modal header
CSV data file download is triggered with UTF-8 BOM encoding
Click the close button (X) in the header
Modal closes cleanly and returns to the Kitchen Dashboard
